name: Ad Nauseam
role: Centerpiece — draw a chunk (or whole library) at life cost
text: Reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. You lose life equal to its mana value. You may repeat this process any number of times.
note: Package centerpiece; honest spell, cast-and-spent (#4/#16)

name: Tendrils of Agony
role: Line A storm kill — drain 2 per prior spell, gain life
printings: F08, MB2, PEWK, PRM, SCG, SLD, STA, VMA
text:
Target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
note: SCG printing = in-block; mono-B storm payoff, lifegain offsets Ad Nauseam

name: Bitter Ordeal
role: Gravestorm kill — exile opponent's library card per permanent that died
text:
Search target player's library for a card and exile it. Then that player shuffles.
Gravestorm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each permanent put into a graveyard this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
note: Non-creature → any-era OK; gravestorm mill kill, bridges to graveyard-storm theme

name: Angel's Grace
role: Line B protection — split-second can't-lose lets Ad Nauseam draw to 1 life
printings: MMA, PLST, PTSR, SOA, TSP, TSR
text:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
You can't lose the game this turn and your opponents can't win the game this turn. Until end of turn, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead.
note: W splash for Modern line; split-second = the correct protector (Everybody Lives! can't)

name: Lightning Storm
role: Line B kill (R) — discard drawn lands to scale X, burn opponent out
text:
Lightning Storm deals X damage to any target, where X is 3 plus the number of charge counters on Lightning Storm.
Discard a land card: Put two charge counters on Lightning Storm. You may choose a new target for it. Any player may activate this ability but only if Lightning Storm is on the stack.
note: R splash kill after drawing library; charge-counter sink fits counter theme

name: Laboratory Maniac
role: Line B kill (U) — win on next draw from empty library; NEVER Thassa's Oracle
printings: FCA, INR, ISD, PLST, SLD, TSR, UMA
text: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
note: Out-of-block creature: structural deck-out payoff, spec-mandated (#4); fragile 2/2

name: Leveler
role: Empties own library on ETB; combos with deck-out win + Sundial
text: When this creature enters, exile all cards from your library.
note: Artifact CREATURE → Out-exception; empties library for Labman/Jace or Sundial line (#13)

name: Sundial of the Infinite
role: End turn before empty-library draw = Stifle for Leveler's draw-step loss (#13)
text: {1}, {T}: End the turn. Activate only during your turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack. Discard down to your maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)
note: Spec #13: Stifle the Leveler draw-step loss; non-creature artifact, any era

name: Spoils of the Vault
role: Dig to a combo piece, paying life — pairs with Phyrexian Unlife / Ad Nauseam
text: Choose a card name. Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card with that name, then put that card into your hand. Exile all other cards revealed this way, and you lose 1 life for each of the exiled cards.
note: Spec-named tutor; self-mill + life loss = on-theme fragile dig, not a staple

name: Phyrexian Unlife
role: Life buffer at 0 — enables deep Ad Nauseam / Spoils without dying
text:
You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
As long as you have 0 or less life, all damage is dealt to you as though its source had infect. (Damage is dealt to you in the form of poison counters.)
note: Spec-named; W splash buffer (Ad Nauseam past 0). Poison-counter theme bonus

name: Grapeshot
role: Alt storm kill (R) — 1 damage per prior spell to any target
text:
Grapeshot deals 1 damage to any target.
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
note: R-splash storm finisher; redundant with Tendrils — pick one in singleton final cut

name: Empty the Warrens
role: Storm payoff making Goblins — board-presence storm, slower/fairer kill
text:
Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn.)
note: Low-power storm: tokens not instant-kill; fits incremental small-games ethos

name: Brain Freeze
role: Mill-storm — deck opponent out, or self-mill toward Labman/Jace
text:
Target player mills three cards.
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
note: U storm kill (mill); also self-empties library for the draw-out payoffs

name: Jace, Wielder of Mysteries
role: Backup deck-out win (U) — static replaces empty-library draw with a win
text:
If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
[+1]: Target player mills two cards. Draw a card.
[-8]: Draw seven cards. Then if your library has no cards in it, you win the game.
note: Redundant Labman that survives removal; static is the win-replacement, not value engine

name: Dark Ritual
role: Ritual fuel — +2 mana and +1 storm count to power the combo turn
text: Add {B}{B}{B}.
note: Fast mana, but intended fragile-payoff fuel (#5); 1 copy only, no LED-tier mana

name: Cabal Ritual
role: Threshold ritual fuel — big mana late, storm-count enabler
text:
Add {B}{B}{B}.
Threshold — Add {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} instead if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
note: In-block (TOR) ritual; threshold rewards graveyard-storm; fuel for combo turn

name: Songs of the Damned
role: Graveyard ritual — explosive mana off a full yard, storm-count fuel
text: Add {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
note: Needs a full yard → fragile, build-around; bridges to graveyard-storm theme

name: Sign in Blood
role: Card draw at life cost + storm count; pre-combo dig
text: Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
note: Cheap draw + storm; life-loss synergy with Phyrexian Unlife / Mirror Universe deck

name: Night's Whisper
role: Card draw at life cost + storm count; pre-combo dig
text: You draw two cards and lose 2 life.
note: Redundant with Sign in Blood (singleton: keep both, both find homes)

name: Gitaxian Probe
role: Free cantrip — +1 storm count for effectively 0 mana (Phyrexian U or 2 life)
text:
({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)
Look at target player's hand.
Draw a card.
note: Free storm-count + cantrip; classic storm enabler, low standalone power

name: Street Wraith
role: Free cantrip via cycle for 2 life — +1 storm count, thins/digs
text:
Swampwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.)
Cycling—Pay 2 life. (Pay 2 life, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
note: Out-of-block creature but only ever cycled (free storm cantrip, 2 life); never hard-cast

name: Dark Petition
role: Tutor that refunds BBB with spell mastery — finds Ad Nauseam, semi-rituals
text:
Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, add {B}{B}{B}.
note: Slow build-around tutor (spell mastery) — on-theme vs Demonic Tutor (excluded)

name: Infernal Tutor
role: Hellbent tutor — finds the combo piece when hand is empty (storm-natural)
text:
Reveal a card from your hand. Search your library for a card with the same name as that card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Hellbent — If you have no cards in hand, instead search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
note: Conditional tutor (needs empty hand / a duplicate) → fragile, build-around

name: Demonic Consultation
role: Cheap dig that self-exiles 6+ cards — tutor AND a self-mill toward deck-out
text: Choose a card name. Exile the top six cards of your library, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card with the chosen name. Put that card into your hand and exile all other cards revealed this way.
note: Efficient but self-mill risk is the cost; doubles as deck-out enabler for Labman
